description: Console messages and uncaught exceptions of the app: renderer windows and main process (up to the last 1000). source "stdout" returns the raw output of an app started with launch_app.

app.description: App: id (its CDP port) or name from list_windows. Optional with a single app.

level.description: Comma-separated levels to keep: log, info, warn, error, debug

window.description: Only this window (plus the main process)

name: get_console_logs
title: Console logs
